stories.headline: PM Takaichi's LDP wins historic supermajority in snap election landslide
stories.summary: Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi's Liberal Democratic Party achieved its biggest victory since 1955, winning 316 seats in the February 8 Lower House election - a two-thirds supermajority that allows the party to override Upper House vetoes. The victory strengthens Takaichi's mandate for conservative policies including tax cuts and constitutional revision.

stories.headline: Emperor Naruhito's 66th birthday celebrations and diplomatic activities
stories.summary: Japanese embassies worldwide hosted receptions to celebrate Emperor Naruhito's 66th birthday on February 23, with events in Qatar, Turkmenistan, and Saipan. The Emperor also met with Nepalese President Ramchandra Paudel and attended memorial ceremonies during the week.

stories.headline: Constitutional revision discussions gain momentum after LDP supermajority
stories.summary: Following the LDP's two-thirds majority win, 93% of elected lawmakers support constitutional amendments according to surveys. The government plans to draft Japan's first national intelligence strategy and establish anti-espionage laws, with constitutional revision becoming a realistic possibility.

stories.headline: Opposition parties reorganize after election defeat
stories.summary: The Constitutional Democratic Party and Komeito decided against forming a unified caucus in the Upper House following their poor election performance. Both parties are undergoing leadership changes, with the Centrist Reform Alliance electing new leaders after co-leaders resigned.

stories.headline: Japanese markets hit record highs after LDP election victory
stories.summary: The Nikkei 225 crossed 57,000 for the first time and hit record highs following Takaichi's landslide win. Business groups including Keidanren welcomed the political stability, while the yen strengthened against the dollar on election outcome optimism.

stories.headline: Takaichi pushes for early budget passage following election mandate
stories.summary: Prime Minister Takaichi instructed senior LDP members to ensure thorough Diet management and early passage of the budget proposal at a special session convening Wednesday. She emphasized delivering tax cuts including the proposed two-year suspension of consumption tax on food items.
